label: _Scripted demo plan (no AI model is connected). Interpretations are AI hypotheses; drill dimensions are assumptions. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Milwaukee Tool._
examplePrompt: Start the drill bit holder example

arguments.text: Drill bit holder for a Milwaukee-compatible cordless drill/driver (M12 or M18). It must hold six hex-shank driver bits with a 1/4 in hex shank of 6.35 mm, keep every bit retained after a drop from 1 m, and let the user take a bit out with one hand within 3 s. Assume the holder attaches at the belt-clip mount of the drill. Assume the drill body dimensions are not measured yet; any drill dimension used later is an assumption until it is measured.

arguments.text: Alternative A: magnetic clip-on bit holder at the belt-clip mount. Bits sit in a row of hex sockets with a magnet behind each socket.
Alternative B: bit holder sleeve on the battery foot. A flexible sleeve with hex pockets slides over the drill foot above the battery.
Alternative C: separate belt holster with a bit strip. The holder is not on the drill; the user carries it on the belt.

stages.reply:
I prepared three alternatives as Concepts under ${key}: ${proposals}.

**Small trade study (AI hypothesis, scores 1–5, higher is better):**

| Criterion (weight) | A: magnetic clip at belt-clip mount | B: sleeve on battery foot | C: belt holster |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Retention after a 1 m drop (3) | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| One-handed access (2) | 5 | 4 | 2 |
| Fit without measured drill dimensions (2) | 3 | 2 | 5 |
| Added mass on the drill (1) | 3 | 3 | 5 |
| **Weighted total** | **31** | **27** | **31** |

**Proposed decision (for you or a reviewer to record):** pursue **A** for on-tool, one-handed access and keep **C** as the fallback. A and C tie at 31; C scores well only because it does not depend on the drill’s dimensions, so measure the belt-clip mount before committing to A.

Limitation: the Conceptualize operations available to the assistant cannot yet record named alternatives in an alternative set with this trade study, so the alternatives are child Concepts and the table is shown here, not stored.
